tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The screen behind everything: graphite at night, pale stone by day. The sky gradient for the hour is painted over it.

tokens.name: material
tokens.usage: Translucent widget fill over ground and the sky, always with a 40px background blur.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Solid sheets above everything: confirmations, room controls. One at a time.

tokens.name: fill-control
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and icon discs for things that are off.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: 1px lines between rows in a list.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and the clock, on ground, material and surface-raised.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, units, captions, on ground, material and surface-raised.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Everything you can tap: primary buttons, links, selected controls, sliders. The colour of the upper air the product is named for.

tokens.name: on-mist
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on a mist fill.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Aether's presence only: the orb, the line that names who is speaking, the agent working in the Now bar. Never on buttons.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: On, locked, healthy, done. Always with a word or a checkmark.

tokens.name: candle
tokens.usage: Icon disc fill for lights that are on. Icons on it use ground (dark) or white (light).

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Needs a person: a failed action, a door unlocked at night. Always with a word.

styles.name: clock-far
styles.usage: The clock when nobody is near the screen. Readable from across the room.

styles.name: clock-near
styles.usage: The clock when someone stands at the screen and the widgets are showing.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: The one sentence that matters: a question from Aether, the next event.

styles.name: glance
styles.usage: The single line under the far clock. One line, the most useful thing right now.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Widget titles, row titles, room names.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its text; between a title and its footnote.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between items inside a widget; gap between widgets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Widget and sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Screen margin when near.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Screen margin when far: the clock floats with room around it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: List rows, home tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Widgets and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon discs, the Now bar, the orb.
